name: Apply Promo Code at Checkout
user_story: As a shopper, I want to apply a promo code at checkout so that I receive a discount on my order.
description: At checkout there is a Promo code input and an Apply button. When a valid code is applied, the discount is reflected in the order summary and the total updates. An invalid or ineligible code shows an error and the total is unchanged.
promo_rules: Percentage codes: SAVE10 = 10% off item subtotal.
Fixed amount codes: FLAT200 = ₹200 off item subtotal.
Some codes require a minimum subtotal; FLAT200 requires subtotal ≥ ₹1000.
A single-use code cannot be reused by the same customer after redemption.
Only one promo code may be applied; a second replaces the first only after confirmation.
Fixed discount is capped so discounted subtotal never goes below ₹0.
Discount applies to subtotal only; shipping and taxes are calculated on discounted subtotal.

acceptance_criteria.text: Applying SAVE10 to a ₹1000 subtotal reduces it by ₹100; the order total updates accordingly.
Applying FLAT200 to a ₹1500 subtotal reduces it by ₹200.
Applying FLAT200 to an ₹800 subtotal is rejected with "This code requires a minimum order of ₹1000."
Applying an expired code shows "This code has expired." and the total is unchanged.
Applying a non-existent code shows "Invalid promo code." and the total is unchanged.
Reapplying a single-use code already redeemed by the customer shows "This code has already been used."
Applying FLAT200 to a ₹150 subtotal (where minimum is not required) results in a subtotal of ₹0, never negative.
Applying a second code prompts the user to replace the first; on confirm, only the new discount applies.
Clicking Apply with no code shows "Enter a promo code."
Leading/trailing spaces are trimmed before validation.
If the cart changes after a code is applied (e.g., an item is removed and subtotal drops below the minimum), the discount is re-validated and removed if no longer eligible.
